newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola rises at close on crusher, Japan demand.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola rises at close on crusher, Japan demand.

text.p: WCE canola futures ended mostly higher on crusher and Japanese demand, traders said.

"ADM bought November, the Japanese bought November scale down and MOC (market on close), locals covered shorts and there were light hedges in the May and July," a trader said. May WCE futures crush profit margin fell to -14.69 Thursday from -14.06 Wednesday. May-July spread at $0.50, Mar-July $4.50. Volume was 6,865 lots with 1,055 hedges lots.
Japan bought 3,000-4,000 tonnes overnight, sources said.
May canola rose $0.70 to $424.90, July fell $0.20 to $425.30 and November rose $1.80 to $372.
May flax rose $2 to $359 on RBC-DS demand, July up $2 to $358.50 on Cargill buying. U.S. crushers were bought 5,000 tonnes, traders said. Volume was 450 lots with 125 hedges.
May feed wheat rose $1.60 to $170.80 on commercial buying, July up $1.70 to $168.90. Mar-May spread at $8.50, May-July $2.50. Volume was 856 lots. Oats and peas did not trade.
March western barley rose $0.50 to $142.40 on commercials as CBOT corn rose, May up $0.30 to $143.20. May-Oct spread at $3.50, Oct-Dec at even money, Mar-May $0.50. Volume 1,500.
(All values in Canadian dollars, except feed peas)
